    WARNING: DO NOT REORDER THESE SCRIPTS.

    Required order: denied consent defaults → Osano (slot) → GTM loader.
    Loading GTM before the defaults can let tags run without the intended consent state.
    Osano must execute before GTM to meet its installation requirements.
    Keep Osano synchronous: async or defer breaks this ordering.
-->
<script>(function(){const consent = {"ad_storage":"denied","ad_user_data":"denied","ad_personalization":"denied","analytics_storage":"denied","functionality_storage":"denied","personalization_storage":"denied","security_storage":"denied"};

    window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || []

    window.gtag =
        window.gtag ||
        function () {
            window.dataLayer.push(arguments)
        }

    gtag('consent', 'default', { ...consent, wait_for_update: 1000 })
})();</script>

        <script>
            // Smooth scrolling is switched on only once the page has loaded (see the
            // `html[data-loaded]` rule below). The browser's initial scroll to a URL
            // fragment must stay instant: when it is animated, the destination is
            // fixed at first layout, and the reflow caused by web fonts arriving a
            // moment later leaves the page stranded far below the linked heading.
            window.addEventListener(
                'load',
                () => {
                    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-loaded', '')
                },
                { once: true },
            )

            <div data-astro-cid-wv6h5znq>

        <div data-astro-cid-wv6h5znq>
            <div class="prose-help-center" data-astro-cid-tf6vuv5l>
    <article id="introduction" data-astro-cid-nbzjzldq="true" class="prose-wrapper content">
    
            <p class="prose-text prose-body-base">
    When you set a time for a task, sometimes you’ll want the time to adjust based on the time zone you’re in. Other times you’ll want the time to stay fixed in your current time zone no matter where you are.
</p><p class="prose-text prose-body-base">
    To choose between the two, you can set a <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>floating time </strong>or a <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>fixed time </strong>for your tasks to make sure things get done when they’re supposed to, wherever you are. Here’s a bit more about the two options:
</p><h2 id="h_01HB80PRNGD45AMBXW6A7TB2KQ" data-astro-cid-m75qu4kf="true" class="prose-text prose-major-base prose-heading"><span class="prose-heading-content" data-astro-cid-m75qu4kf>
            <heading-anchor class="prose-heading-button" data-heading-id="h_01HB80PRNGD45AMBXW6A7TB2KQ" data-astro-cid-m75qu4kf="true">
                <svg width="16" height="16" color="currentColor" class="prose-heading-link" data-astro-cid-m75qu4kf="true"><use href="/static/icons/generated/brand-icons.svg#link"></use></svg>
                <svg width="16" height="16" color="currentColor" class="prose-heading-check" data-astro-cid-m75qu4kf="true"><use href="/static/icons/generated/brand-icons.svg#check"></use></svg>
            </heading-anchor>
            <span data-astro-cid-m75qu4kf>Floating time </span>
        </span></h2>

<p class="prose-text prose-body-base">
    If you set a <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>floating time</strong>, the due time of your task will stay the same regardless of your time zone. For example, a task scheduled at 9am New York time will also be scheduled at 9am when on London time.
</p><p class="prose-text prose-body-base">
    If you travel from New York to London, the task will stay scheduled for 9am. If you share the project with someone in London, the task will appear due at 9am for both of you, even though you and your collaborator are not in the same time zone.
</p><p class="prose-text prose-body-base">
    All due times in Todoist are floating by default.
</p><h2 id="h_01HB80PRNGM6DXE3PPXMBTKJN1" data-astro-cid-m75qu4kf="true" class="prose-text prose-major-base prose-heading"><span class="prose-heading-content" data-astro-cid-m75qu4kf>
            <heading-anchor class="prose-heading-button" data-heading-id="h_01HB80PRNGM6DXE3PPXMBTKJN1" data-astro-cid-m75qu4kf="true">
                <svg width="16" height="16" color="currentColor" class="prose-heading-link" data-astro-cid-m75qu4kf="true"><use href="/static/icons/generated/brand-icons.svg#link"></use></svg>
                <svg width="16" height="16" color="currentColor" class="prose-heading-check" data-astro-cid-m75qu4kf="true"><use href="/static/icons/generated/brand-icons.svg#check"></use></svg>
            </heading-anchor>
            <span data-astro-cid-m75qu4kf>Fixed time</span>
        </span></h2>

<p class="prose-text prose-body-base">
    If you set a <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>fixed time</strong>, the due time of your task will adjust based on that time zone. For example, a task due at 9am New York time will be due at 2pm London time.
</p><p class="prose-text prose-body-base">
    If you travel from New York to London, the task’s due time will update to 2pm. If you share the project with someone in London, the task will appear due at 9am for you and 2pm for your collaborator.
</p><div class="prose-note prose-note-note" data-nosnippet data-astro-cid-2bkhkfdf>
    <div class="prose-note-side" data-astro-cid-2bkhkfdf>
        
                
                <svg width="16" height="16" color="currentColor" data-astro-cid-2bkhkfdf="true"><use href="/static/icons/generated/brand-icons.svg#info-circle"></use></svg>
                
            
    </div>
    <div class="prose-note-main" data-astro-cid-2bkhkfdf>
        <div class="prose-note-header" data-astro-cid-2bkhkfdf>
                    <p class="prose-note-title" data-astro-cid-2bkhkfdf>
                        <span class="prose-text prose-minor-base prose-semiBold" data-astro-cid-2bkhkfdf>Note</span>
                        
                        
                    </p>
                </div>
        <div class="prose-note-content prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-2bkhkfdf>
            When selecting a fixed time, you can only choose your current time zone. In case another user selected a different time zone, then you’ll also see a third option to keep the task’s current time zone.
        </div>
</div>
</div><p class="prose-text prose-body-base">
    Choose between setting a floating time or fixed time for your task on any platform:
</p><help-center-platforms class="prose-platforms" data-astro-cid-hl4ocqk5="true">
    <div class="prose-platform-selector" data-astro-cid-hl4ocqk5>
        <label for="platform-select-b291u3cx0" class="prose-text prose-minor-base prose-semiBold" data-astro-cid-hl4ocqk5>
            Select Platform:
        </label>
        <div class="prose-select-wrapper" data-astro-cid-tj7d7y5j>
    <div class="prose-select-field" data-astro-cid-tj7d7y5j>
        <select id="platform-select-b291u3cx0" class="prose-select prose-text prose-minor-sm" data-astro-cid-hl4ocqk5="true" data-astro-cid-tj7d7y5j>
            <option value="web mac windows-10" data-astro-cid-hl4ocqk5>
                    Web, macOS, Windows 10/11
                </option><option value="ios" data-astro-cid-hl4ocqk5>
                    iOS
                </option><option value="android" data-astro-cid-hl4ocqk5>
                    Android
                </option>
        </select>
        <span class="prose-select-arrow" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-tj7d7y5j>
            <svg width="16" height="16" color="currentColor" data-astro-cid-tj7d7y5j="true"><use href="/static/icons/generated/brand-icons.svg#double-arrows"></use></svg>
        </span>
    </div>
</div>
    </div>

    <div class="prose-platform-content" data-astro-cid-hl4ocqk5>
        <div dataPlatform="web mac windows-10"><ol data-astro-cid-ig77lutk="true"><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>When adding or editing a task, click the <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>Date</strong> field in the task view, or the <span class="prose-icon-inline" data-astro-cid-tkgrxnfm>
    
    
    <svg width="20" height="20" color="currentColor" name="CalendarDate" data-astro-cid-tkgrxnfm="true"><use href="/static/icons/generated/web-icons.svg#calendar-date"></use></svg>
    
    </span><strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>calendar icon</strong>.</li><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>Click <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>Time</strong> at the bottom of the scheduler.</li><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>Enter a due time for your task and click the <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>Time zone</strong> menu.</li><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>Choose whether you want to use a fixed time or floating time.
<p class="prose-text prose-body-base">
    If a collaborator already set the task&#39;s time zone, you’ll see a third option to keep it.
</p></li><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>Click <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>Save</strong> to save your changes.</li></ol></div><div dataPlatform="ios"><ol data-astro-cid-ig77lutk="true"><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>When adding or editing a task, tap the <span class="prose-icon-inline" data-astro-cid-tkgrxnfm>
    <svg width="20" height="20" color="currentColor" name="CalendarDate" data-astro-cid-tkgrxnfm="true"><use href="/static/icons/generated/ios-icons.svg#calendar-date"></use></svg>
    
    
    
    </span><strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>calendar icon</strong> to open the task scheduler.</li><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>Type a date or select a date from the calendar.</li><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>Tap <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>Time</strong> at the bottom.</li><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>Select a due time from the time picker. You can add <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://www.todoist.com/help/todoist/features/set-a-task-duration-L1kYkZv8d" data-astro-cid-35p5tzud>duration</a>, if needed.</li><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>Tap <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>Time zone</strong> and choose either a fixed time (represented by your current time zone) or floating time.
<p class="prose-text prose-body-base">
    If a collaborator already set the task&#39;s time zone, you’ll see a third option to keep it.
</p></li><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>Tap <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>Save</strong> to save your changes.</li></ol></div><div dataPlatform="android"><p class="prose-text prose-body-base">
    On Android, there are two different ways to set a fixed time or floating time.
</p><p class="prose-text prose-body-base">
    When using the calendar:
</p><ol data-astro-cid-ig77lutk="true"><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>When adding or editing a task, simply tap on the calendar icon to open the task scheduler.</li><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>Select a date from the calendar and tap on <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>+ Add Time</strong> in the bottom-left corner.</li><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>Select a due time and tap on <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>Time zone</strong> underneath the time picker.</li><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>Choose whether you want to set a fixed time (represented by your current time zone) or floating time by tapping on the option you would like to use, and tap on <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>OK</strong>. (If the time zone of the task has already been set by someone else in a different time zone, you’ll also see a third option to keep the task’s current time zone.)</li><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>Once you’ve done this, tap on <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>Schedule </strong>or <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>Reschedule</strong> in the bottom-right corner of the scheduler to save your task.</li></ol><p class="prose-text prose-body-base">
    When typing a date and time:
</p><ol data-astro-cid-ig77lutk="true"><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>When adding or editing a task, tap on the calendar icon to open the task scheduler.</li><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>At the top of the scheduler, type in the date and time and tap on <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>Time Zone</strong>.</li><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>Choose whether you want to set a <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>fixed time</strong> (represented by your current time zone) or <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>floating time</strong> by tapping on the option you would like to use, and tap on the <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>submit arrow</strong>. (If the time zone of the task has already been set by someone else in a different time zone, you’ll also see a third option to keep the task’s current time zone.)</li><li class="prose-text prose-body-base" data-astro-cid-ez5b27bs>Depending on your Android device, you may need to tap on a <strong data-astro-cid-m6e2taww>submit arrow</strong> in order to save your task.</li></ol></div>
    </div>
</help-center-platforms>

<h2 id="h_01HB80PRNGKCKZZRBWWXWMMYSA" data-astro-cid-m75qu4kf="true" class="prose-text prose-major-base prose-heading"><span class="prose-heading-content" data-astro-cid-m75qu4kf>
            <heading-anchor class="prose-heading-button" data-heading-id="h_01HB80PRNGKCKZZRBWWXWMMYSA" data-astro-cid-m75qu4kf="true">
                <svg width="16" height="16" color="currentColor" class="prose-heading-link" data-astro-cid-m75qu4kf="true"><use href="/static/icons/generated/brand-icons.svg#link"></use></svg>
                <svg width="16" height="16" color="currentColor" class="prose-heading-check" data-astro-cid-m75qu4kf="true"><use href="/static/icons/generated/brand-icons.svg#check"></use></svg>
            </heading-anchor>
            <span data-astro-cid-m75qu4kf>FAQ</span>
        </span></h2>

<doist-accordion data-astro-cid-ymw5anec="true" class="prose-accordion">
    <div class="prose-accordion-item" data-astro-cid-fyj76qbj>
    <button class="prose-accordion-button" type="button" data-astro-cid-fyj76qbj>
        <h4 class="_text_qx30j_1 _minor-lg_qx30j_131 prose-accordion-question" data-astro-cid-fyj76qbj="true">
            What is the default behaviour for my due times?
        </h4>
        <svg width="20" height="20" color="currentColor" class="prose-accordion-icon" data-astro-cid-fyj76qbj="true"><use href="/static/icons/generated/brand-icons.svg#plus"></use></svg>
    </button>
    <div class="prose-accordion-answer" role="region" data-astro-cid-fyj76qbj>
        <div class="prose-accordion-answer-inner" data-astro-cid-fyj76qbj>
            <p class="prose-text prose-body-base">
    The due time of your task will be floating by default.
</p>
        </div>
    </div>
</div><div class="prose-accordion-item" data-astro-cid-fyj76qbj>
    <button class="prose-accordion-button" type="button" data-astro-cid-fyj76qbj>
        <h4 class="_text_qx30j_1 _minor-lg_qx30j_131 prose-accordion-question" data-astro-cid-fyj76qbj="true">
            Can I schedule a task for a different time zone?
        </h4>
        <svg width="20" height="20" color="currentColor" class="prose-accordion-icon" data-astro-cid-fyj76qbj="true"><use href="/static/icons/generated/brand-icons.svg#plus"></use></svg>
    </button>
    <div class="prose-accordion-answer" role="region" data-astro-cid-fyj76qbj>
        <div class="prose-accordion-answer-inner" data-astro-cid-fyj76qbj>
            <p class="prose-text prose-body-base">
    No. You will only have the option to choose your current time zone unless the time zone has already been set by someone else, in that case you’ll also have the option to keep the task’s current time zone.
</p>
        </div>
    </div>
</div><div class="prose-accordion-item" data-astro-cid-fyj76qbj>
    <button class="prose-accordion-button" type="button" data-astro-cid-fyj76qbj>
        <h4 class="_text_qx30j_1 _minor-lg_qx30j_131 prose-accordion-question" data-astro-cid-fyj76qbj="true">
            I would like to set one of my devices to a time zone that doesn’t match my physical location so I can keep track of my deadlines in a different time zone. How can I do this?
        </h4>
        <svg width="20" height="20" color="currentColor" class="prose-accordion-icon" data-astro-cid-fyj76qbj="true"><use href="/static/icons/generated/brand-icons.svg#plus"></use></svg>
    </button>
    <div class="prose-accordion-answer" role="region" data-astro-cid-fyj76qbj>
        <div class="prose-accordion-answer-inner" data-astro-cid-fyj76qbj>
            <p class="prose-text prose-body-base">
    By setting a floating time for your tasks, you can make sure that the due time will stay the same across all your devices, regardless of the time zone they have been set to.
</p>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</doist-accordion>


        
</article>
</div>
        </div>
    
</div>
